name: com.cooperemail/cooper-email
title: Cooper Email
description: Email inboxes for AI agents: send, receive, search, drafts with owner approval, and webhooks.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer coop_live_ API key from unauthenticated cooper_onboard or POST /api/v1/onboard. That key is not attached to a later OAuth login. OAuth 2.1 (PKCE) uses the signed-in account, which can be a different inbox. Discovery: https://cooperemail.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.
